CREATIVE ARTS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Remove the need for rules

2. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.

3. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.
   B. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.

4. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)

   A. The speed of the music
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. Only the volume

9. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)

   B. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.

12. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
